s-1.ptxt: Dispose of Curtain Shield Airbag Assembly RH (Disposal on Vehicle)

item.ptxt: Perform deployment outdoors on a flat surface where safety can be ensured. Also, avoid deployment in residential areas as much as possible.
The deployment noise is loud, so thoroughly notify people in advance that deployment will be performed.

atten4.ptxt: Dispose of the LH side using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s3.ptxt: Short the alligator clip and terminal of the SST.
Connect the SST to the curtain shield airbag RH and lock it securely.

atten2.ptxt: Check that the curtain shield airbag RH has no looseness.

s3.ptxt: Extend the SST fully from the vehicle and place the battery at least 5m away from the vehicle.

atten2.ptxt: Close all doors and door glass.

s3.ptxt: After confirming safety inside the cabin and in the surrounding area, connect the alligator clip of the SST to the negative terminal of the battery.
Connect the SST terminal to the positive terminal of the battery to deploy the curtain shield airbag RH.

item.ptxt: Before deployment, always make sure that there is no one inside the cabin or in the surrounding area.
Before deployment, always warn people around the vehicle being disposed of in a loud voice.

atten4.ptxt: The connector of the SST (wire B) that connects directly to the inflator will melt after 1 deployment due to the heat of the inflator.

s2.ptxt: Disposal Procedure for Curtain Shield Airbag RH

s3.ptxt: Place the deployed curtain shield airbag RH in a strong, transparent plastic bag, seal it and dispose of it.

item.ptxt: Parts of the deployed curtain shield airbag RH may be at a high temperature of several hundred °C or more, so leave it for 30 minutes or more after deployment.
Do not apply water, etc. to the deployed curtain shield airbag RH.
When handling the deployed curtain shield airbag RH, wear dust-proof protective glasses and gloves.
Never dispose of the curtain shield airbag RH without deploying it.
Always wash your hands with water after completing work.

s-1.ptxt: Dispose of Curtain Shield Airbag Assembly RH (Disposal off Vehicle)

item.ptxt: Perform deployment outdoors on a flat surface where safety can be ensured. Also, avoid deployment in residential areas as much as possible.
The deployment noise is loud, so thoroughly notify people in advance that deployment will be performed.

atten4.ptxt: Dispose of the LH side using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s3.ptxt: Cut off the deployment section of the curtain shield airbag RH.
Using a wire harness (conductor cross-sectional area 1.25mm2or more), secure the curtain shield airbag RH to a tire.

item.ptxt: Strictly observe the following 2 instructions. If the instructions are not followed, the deployed curtain shield airbag RH or tires may be thrown about, which may result in serious injury.
A force of approximately 1 tons is applied to the wire harness when the curtain shield airbag RH deploys, so wrap the wire harness 3 times and secure it firmly with no slack.
As shown in the illustration, always install the curtain shield airbag RH with its deployment surface facing the center of the tire.

s3.ptxt: Short the alligator clip and terminal of the SST.
Connect the SST to the curtain shield airbag RH and lock it securely.
As shown in the illustration, stack 2 tires, place the tire with the curtain shield airbag RH secured on top of them, then place 1 more tires on top and a tire with disc wheel at the very top.

item.ptxt: Always face the deployment section (tip) of the curtain shield airbag RH toward the center of the tire.
Never face the deployment section (tip) of the curtain shield airbag RH toward the ground.
Select tires of a width that prevents the deployment section (tip) from entering between the stacked tires.

s3.ptxt: Using wire with a diameter of 1.8mm or more (general-purpose ordinary iron wire: equivalent to JIS SWM-B), wrap the tires together 2 times or more and tie them securely with no slack.

atten3.ptxt: Secure them so that the total load capacity is 1 tons or more.

s3.ptxt: Extend the SST fully from the curtain shield airbag RH and place the battery at least 5m away from the tires.
Surround the area within a radius of 5m from the outside of the tires with pylons and rope, etc. so that no one can enter.
After confirming safety in the surrounding area, connect the alligator clip of the SST to the negative terminal of the battery.

item.ptxt: Perform deployment outdoors on a flat surface where safety can be ensured. Also, avoid deployment in residential areas as much as possible.
The deployment noise is loud, so thoroughly notify people in advance that deployment will be performed.

s3.ptxt: Connect the SST terminal to the positive terminal of the battery to deploy the curtain shield airbag RH.

item.ptxt: Before deployment, always make sure that there is no one in the surrounding area.
Before deployment, always warn people around the work area in a loud voice.

atten4.ptxt: The connector of the SST (wire B) that connects directly to the inflator will melt after 1 deployment due to the heat of the inflator.

s2.ptxt: Disposal Procedure for Curtain Shield Airbag RH

s3.ptxt: Place the deployed curtain shield airbag RH in a strong, transparent plastic bag, seal it and dispose of it.

item.ptxt: Parts of the deployed curtain shield airbag RH may be at a high temperature of several hundred °C or more, so leave it for 30 minutes or more after deployment.
Do not apply water, etc. to the deployed curtain shield airbag RH.
When handling the deployed curtain shield airbag RH, wear dust-proof protective glasses and gloves.
Never dispose of the curtain shield airbag RH without deploying it.
Always wash your hands with water after completing work.
